ceilidh_caller.text: Fàilte! Come in, come in. Ceilidh is a Gaelic word, cèilidh, and it just means a visit, a gathering of friends.
Tonight it's the Gay Gordons, Strip the Willow and the Dashing White Sergeant. Nobody's allowed to sit out. I'll find you.
Slàinte mhath! Don't worry about getting the steps wrong. Everyone's wrong together, and that's the whole point.

ceilidh_fiddler.text: I've played the Dashing White Sergeant four hundred times. It still gets me, mostly in the left wrist.
